pi.bio: Benedikt Zott is a neuroscientist and neuroradiologist at the Technical University of Munich. His research asks how β-amyloid disrupts hippocampal circuits in the earliest stages of Alzheimer’s disease — and whether these changes can be prevented or reversed — combining in vivo two-photon imaging, electrophysiology and histology in mouse models.
